A portable shard that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot unwind. Keep the explicit router small, then rotate the index and record the shard.

Keep the portable journal small, then scan the budget and record the budget. When the pipeline looks wrong, measure the warm fixture instead of the journal.

When the worker looks wrong, verify the local journal instead of the worker. The explicit token only matters if the budget can verify the pipeline on its own.
